crossRefs.note: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no…
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…
He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast…

translations.web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
translations.bsb: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
translations.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth
translations.asv: The righteous is a guide to his neighbor; But the way of the wicked causeth them to err.
